payload.rationale: The packet shows 'Report' in the WET table VALUE column for both Ceriodaphnia dubia and Pimephales promelas at Outfall 001, which is consistent with report-only monitoring in the Part I table format (contrasted with numeric limits elsewhere in the same section). However, footnote (3) explicitly defers to Part II for 'WET testing requirements and additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions,' and Part II is not included in the evidence packet. The table header references 7-Day Chronic Static Renewal/NOEC methodology, under which enforceable pass/fail toxicity criteria may apply even without a numeric VALUE-column limit. The obligation asks whether 'Report' establishes that no enforceable numeric effluent limitation applies and that measurements are subject only to reporting with no numeric exceedance comparison. That full proposition cannot be grounded from the available packet: footnote (3) creates an unresolved dependency on Part II, and the packet itself flags possible evidence insufficiency. ACCEPT is not supported because the referenced Part II requirements are absent and may impose enforceable conditions beyond numeric VALUE-column limits. REJECT is not supported because the VALUE column does show 'Report' rather than numeric limits, and no evidence establishes that numeric limit exceedance comparison applies. Neither adjudication burden is met; UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
